card.name: Ending of fibrinogen in lab-test lists
card.fires_on: Mainly the final piece "ogen" of "fibrinogen" when it follows "fibrin" in lists of coagulation lab changes (anti-factor Xa, antithrombin III, plasminogen). Weaker on a few other word endings in lab or assay text.

modes.label: fibrinogen ending
modes.description: The closing piece of "fibrinogen" in a list of clotting-test changes.
modes.example: levels of anti-factor Xa and antithrombin III, decreased antithrombin III activity, increased levels of fibrinogen and fibrin<<ogen>> activity; increased plasminogen antigen

modes.label: other assay wording
modes.description: Scattered pieces inside assay or lab terms, such as the end of fondaparinux or "e.g.," in assay interference text.
